tests.name: Canonical tables exist (districts, parliamentary_constituencies)
tests.expected: Both tables accessible via service_role with required columns

tests.name: Additive columns exist; constituencies.id primary key preserved
tests.expected: constituencies.id preserved as VARCHAR/string; internal_id and canonical_code present

tests.name: internal_id is NOT NULL, UUID format, and UNIQUE
tests.expected: 119 valid, non-null, unique UUIDs across Telangana ACs

tests.name: canonical_code is correctly formatted and UNIQUE
tests.expected: 119 padded unique canonical codes (TS-AC-001 to TS-AC-119)

tests.name: Telangana pilot entity row counts (1 State, 33 Districts, 17 PCs, 119 ACs)
100% of 119 ACs have valid parliamentary_constituency_id and district_id
tests.expected: 0 unlinked ACs; all 119 resolve to both a District and a PC

tests.name: W012 dataset-version foreign keys resolve
tests.expected: All 6 W013 dataset versions exist in dataset_versions catalog

tests.name: W012 record_provenance_linkages resolve for all pilot entities
All pilot entities have UNVERIFIED data status; zero elevation to OFFICIAL
tests.expected: 100% of pilot dataset versions and provenance records are UNVERIFIED

tests.name: Row Level Security enabled: public read succeeds; anonymous mutation denied
tests.expected: Public read returns 200; anonymous insertions rejected by RLS

tests.name: Backwards compatibility: domain FKs and application queries unaffected
tests.expected: All pre-existing domain queries continue returning HTTP 200

tests.name: District chronology and dataset semantics verified
tests.expected: 31 base districts from ts_districts_2016_v1; 2 addition districts (Mulugu, Narayanpet) from ts_districts_2019_additions_v1

tests.name: Canonical identifier width sufficiency (Full Jayashankar Bhupalpally length 31 verified)
tests.expected: Full untruncated code 'TS-DIST-JAYASHANKAR-BHUPALPALLY' (31 chars) successfully persisted and retrieved
